suitability.rationale: Directly proposes cell-free TAK1 inhibition with an ADP readout, requires interference exclusion, and appropriately limits cellular and selectivity conclusions.
response_quotes: reduced corrected signal indicates reduced biochemical activity only if detection interference is excluded.

procedural_soundness.rationale: Coherent qualification, preparation, reaction, ATP depletion, detection and analysis sequence includes background, vehicle and detection-interference controls. Essential reaction composition, timing, detection settings and reference-control identity remain unresolved, making this an honest outline rather than an executable protocol.
response_quotes: This is a qualification-dependent design, not an execution-ready protocol: enzyme system, reaction composition, timing and detection settings remain unresolved.

numerical_soundness.rationale: Explicitly abstains from specifying a concentration series. Three technical wells are transparently provisional and independent repeats are distinguished; normalization arithmetic is coherent. Null series fields preclude a score of 2.
response_quotes: Top concentration, dilution factor and point count are null because no query-specific solubility, pilot response or compatible concentration range is supplied.

not_assessable_components: Compatibility of ADP-Glo with the proposed TAK1 construct and casein substrate is not established by supplied evidence.
Optimal enzyme, substrate, ATP, buffer, reaction and detection conditions and compound solubility remain unknown.
assumption_handling: Clearly labels ADP-Glo, casein qualification, ATP initiation, triplicate wells and four-parameter fitting as provisional choices. Accurately separates retained assay descriptions from unsupported transfers and explicitly lists unresolved settings.

numeric_check.notes: No concentration series is provided, so endpoints cannot be computed. Three wells per concentration per run are technical replicates; independent-run count is unresolved. Normalization yields 0% inhibition at vehicle signal and 100% at background.

review_reason: Domain review and experimental qualification are needed to establish assay compatibility and operating conditions before execution.
